title: RADAR: Comprehensive Feature Catalogue and Research Roadmap
scope_note: Documentation and proposed study backlog only. Proposed features are not implemented, institutionally approved or guaranteed to improve outcomes. Built status means code exists, not field safety certification.

features.name: Email sign-in and signup
features.description: Local account registration/sign-in accepts ordinary email addresses, including Gmail; signup does not grant school staff privileges.

features.name: Supabase account adapter
features.description: Cloud Auth, recovery, PostgreSQL and private Storage adapters exist. Actual server credentials, account setup and live verification are still required.

features.name: Camarines Norte school directory
features.description: Historical 2020–2021 directory: 377 schools across 12 municipalities. It is a selection aid, not a verified current DepEd inventory.

features.name: Separate school workspaces
features.description: Create an empty school workspace with isolated records/uploads; historical demonstration records are not copied into real schools.

features.name: School membership approval
features.description: Administrators approve new school access requests and assign school-specific roles. Approved users do not need repeated approval at each login.

features.name: Six school roles
features.description: Administrator, inspector, teacher, responder, student and parent permissions are enforced on the server; class and evidence ownership add restrictions.

features.name: School and role restoration
features.description: The last authorized school survives logout/login; school-specific permissions, map context and published imagery restore after access is rechecked.

features.name: Account and access safeguards
features.description: Session expiry, inactive/revoked account checks, profile updates and administrator user/audit tools preserve accountability; public signup never grants private-school authority.

features.name: Campus space register
features.description: Register actual buildings, floors, rooms, use, department/contact, dimensions and identifiers; survey and verify the real campus data.

features.name: Room inspection and QR workflow
features.description: Select or QR-open a registered room, capture/attach evidence, complete the six-area checklist and submit findings or an explicit no-visible-findings record.

features.name: Camera and selected video frames
features.description: Browser photo capture and selected frame extraction retain previews. Physical phone camera/codec performance still needs field testing.

features.name: Manual findings and categories
features.description: Record observations without AI and submit student observations without granting students verification authority.

features.name: Optional room vision
features.description: Consented bounded image analysis through the selected OpenAI/Gemini provider suggests findings; model output is not a confirmed hazard.

features.name: Human review and correction
features.description: Authorized staff review, verify, reject or follow up observations; confidence is an uncalibrated output score, not proof of danger.

features.name: Inspection history and comparison
features.description: Room inspection/correction history and before/after evidence comparisons support documented follow-up rather than invented continuous monitoring.

features.name: Approximate finding placement
features.description: Manual floor-plan pins and optional four-anchor planar calibration can project points onto a calibrated plane; depth and other planes remain unresolved.

features.name: Inspection schedules and reminders
features.description: Record inspection schedules, overdue status, checklist scoring and floor/building coverage. Reminders depend on backend job execution.

features.name: Offline inspection drafts
features.description: Account/school-scoped drafts and photos can be saved on the device and explicitly synced, with idempotent creation and retry progress.

features.name: School location editor
features.description: Authorized staff set real school coordinates and register building pins. Missing locations use a labeled regional overview, not fabricated coordinates.

features.name: Basemaps and campus markers
features.description: Street, satellite, dark and terrain choices, registered building markers and room-linked records; third-party tile availability is network-dependent.

features.name: Campus-wide search
features.description: School-scoped global search covers rooms, buildings, hazards, incidents, alerts and advisories; campus lookup also finds resources/gathering points, subject to permissions.

features.name: Hazard marker filters
features.description: Filter findings by severity, category, verification, date and status; stale or unverified records are not promoted to official clearance.

features.name: Aligned floor plans and features
features.description: Upload aligned plans and register room geometry, exits, doors, windows, ramps, stairs and access points using real source measurements.

features.name: Editable campus zones
features.description: Draw and edit geographic restriction/geological zones. Registered verified restrictions can affect separately verified route planning.

features.name: History snapshots and comparisons
features.description: Compare recorded campus states and historical inspection context; snapshots do not establish current on-site conditions.

features.name: Official vector overlays
features.description: Source-linked GeoJSON/CAP import/fetch, review/expiry and an opt-in USGS earthquake adapter exist. Current agency layers need provision; USGS is not PHIVOLCS PEIS or a campus-impact forecast.

features.name: Real 3D and 360 assets
features.description: Uploaded self-contained GLB and actual panoramas have 2D fallbacks. Prepared first-person navigation needs verified metric geometry and spawn information.

features.name: Measured footprint models
features.description: Generate GLB floor/room footprint planes from confirmed surveyed geometry. This is not an automatically reconstructed or current building interior.

current_groups.title: School imagery, GIS and model-output workflows

features.name: Photo/video campus survey
features.description: Local video sampling, reviewed draft building labels, duplicate-view matching and links to registered rooms; a complete video is not uploaded or exhaustively analyzed.

features.name: Published close-up campus view
features.description: Publish a reviewed survey frame/photo to the selected school dashboard, with bounded zoom, pan, frame selection and clickable registered-building links.

features.name: Upload → Generate GIS draft
features.description: The configured vision provider can propose visible campus-area/building polygons, walkways and possible concerns over a school photo or sampled video views.

features.name: Editable image geometry
features.description: Rename/remove proposals, manually draw missing features and use keyboard point entry. Up to 40 reviewed/manual draft features can be stored.

features.name: Private saved image-map drafts
features.description: Persist selected frames, provisional labels, geometry and review notes to the school. Image access requires inspection permission; saving does not register real buildings.

features.name: Three-anchor geographic placement
features.description: A confirmed top-down view and three known non-collinear coordinates produce approximate affine EPSG:4326 placement, saved with source notes.

features.name: GIS export
features.description: Export image-space draft JSON or approximate placed GeoJSON. Georeferencing is explicit; image pixels are never silently labeled as latitude/longitude.

features.name: Building pin–polygon assessment
features.description: Check selected reviewed/unexpired area layers against registered pins, handling holes and multipolygons. No contact is not a safety finding.

features.name: CNN-output import and review
features.description: Import georeferenced visible-feature polygons with model/version, imagery date, class, confidence and provenance. New layers are pending until reviewed.

features.name: CNN threshold and layer controls
features.description: Pending/rejected model outputs stay out of assessments; selected-layer and confidence changes clear old results. A dedicated CNN is not trained or run by RADAR.

features.name: Photo Route Studio
features.description: Draw/review visible image-space path segments, prepare field checks and save a school sketchbook. Sketches never automatically activate evacuation routes.

features.name: Provider failure recovery
features.description: Timeout/quota/model errors and temporary 502/503/504 availability errors are surfaced. Explicit single-view recovery retains other views; no automatic provider retry/fallback occurs.

features.name: School alert authoring
features.description: Four alert levels with staff-controlled publication, suspension reason/resumption, schedule, expiry and archive.

features.name: Targeted alert audiences
features.description: School, grade, section, building and staff audience enforcement; records distinguish authorized recipients and reads.

features.name: In-app notifications
features.description: Persistent school notifications and read state remain separate from claims of external phone delivery.

features.name: Web push adapter
features.description: HTTPS, VAPID, browser support, permission and recipient subscription are required. Provider acceptance is not phone receipt.

features.name: Twilio SMS adapter
features.description: Consented phone numbers, configured/funded sender, durable jobs and signed provider receipts are supported; live delivery has not been verified.

features.name: Delivery policy and fallback
features.description: Optional consented push-to-SMS/SOS SMS policies distinguish unavailable, failed, accepted and delivered states; ambiguous sends are not automatically resent.

features.name: SOS request and acknowledgement
features.description: Two-second hold and confirmation, silent-intent flag, actual server response, acknowledgement, assignment and resolution. No guaranteed offline delivery.

features.name: Safeguarded cancellation
features.description: Users can cancel their own unacknowledged request or request cancellation after acknowledgement; changes preserve the response record.

features.name: Temporary emergency location
features.description: Explicit active-incident location sharing with accuracy, expiry, stop/delete and authorized responder access; no location trails or background tracking guarantee.

features.name: Offline contacts and peer relay
features.description: Saved contact actions and manual WebRTC/expiring packet-file relay exist. Imported requests are unverified; physical peer transport and real delivery remain unverified.

features.name: Verified walkway register
features.description: Routing depends on registered real connected paths and building endpoints; missing graph connections return unavailable rather than inventing a route.

features.name: Assembly point register
features.description: Register actual gathering points, capacity, accessibility and approved geometry, with a source and responsible school staff.

features.name: Dijkstra route planning
features.description: Plan along available verified graph connections to eligible assembly points; estimated distance/time are not indoor turn-by-turn guidance.

features.name: Closures and restriction avoidance
features.description: Known closed paths and verified restriction polygons can remove graph options. Unreported hazards or dynamic smoke/fire are not modeled.

features.name: Accessible route constraints
features.description: Use registered accessibility attributes and capacity information; actual ramps, gates, gradients and surface conditions must be field-checked.

features.name: Alternative destinations
features.description: Consider another registered gathering point when current constraints or recent full-point information prevent an option.

features.name: Aggregate occupancy readings
features.description: Manual and token-authenticated aggregate room/assembly counts include source/time, nonce replay checks and stale-state marking; sensor accuracy needs testing.

features.name: Nearest registered resources
features.description: Approximate nearest equipment/resource locations use building coordinates; straight-line proximity is not a verified indoor walking route.

features.name: Individual student rosters
features.description: Class/section records link authorized school accounts; assigned-teacher restrictions prevent unrelated teachers from changing a class.

features.name: Roll call statuses and history
features.description: Five attendance statuses, reconciled counts, individual changes and class exports support accountable drills and incident follow-up.

features.name: Authenticated QR check-in
features.description: QR helps an authenticated member check in; possession of a QR code is not identity verification or proof of location.

features.name: CSV roster preview/commit
features.description: Bounded imports preview records, deduplicate, link active student accounts and explicitly commit without overwriting attendance.

features.name: Student observation reports
features.description: Submit observations/evidence and follow own status. Policy-controlled identity hiding is limited; authorized investigators retain accountability.

features.name: Corroboration and duplicate flags
features.description: One-vote-per-account/type corroboration and possible-duplicate suggestions aid human review; no automatic certified merge occurs.

features.name: Guardian relationships and status
features.description: School-approved guardian relationships expose limited authorized reported status without precise emergency locations or medical information.

features.name: School emergency settings
features.description: Configure actual contacts, procedures, reporting policy and follow-up intervals. No external agency is automatically contacted by editing a setting.

features.name: Equipment and stock register
features.description: Record location, stock, condition and expiry for registered school equipment/resources; data freshness depends on staff updates.

features.name: Resource transaction journal
features.description: Checkout, return, consumption and replenishment records enforce nonnegative stock and support accountability.

features.name: Stock and expiry reminders
features.description: Low-stock, condition and expiry reminders depend on the configured maintenance/job process and valid staff records.

features.name: Corrective and recovery tasks
features.description: Track damage follow-up, repair/correction and recovery work; the app does not perform repairs or guarantee clearance.

features.name: Private assistance requests
features.description: Restricted assistance/referral requests and staff updates support follow-up; real services must be arranged by authorized people.

features.name: Operational dashboard
features.description: School safety summaries, inspection coverage, overdue work, unresolved severity/status and actual incidents avoid invented live measurements.

features.name: Trend and recurrence review
features.description: Time/status/response trends and repeated concern groups support retrospective review; they are not validated hazard forecasts.

features.name: Allowlisted custom reports
features.description: Filtered/grouped reports and authorized CSV exports use permitted dimensions rather than arbitrary SQL; spreadsheet formulas are neutralized where applicable.

features.name: Five-second opening and replay
features.description: RADAR shield/radar animation plays on fresh loads, including signed-in reloads; Skip, replay and reduced motion are available without replaying every internal navigation.

features.name: Role-aware getting-started tour
features.description: Versioned account/browser-local tour explains the campus, tools and new features; completion/replay never changes permissions.

features.name: Responsive task workspace
features.description: Search/pin tools, task groups, theme choices, compact campus tabs, prerequisite-aware empty states, mobile dock and keyboard controls reduce repeated panels.

features.name: Interface motion and accessibility
features.description: Panel entrances, moving tab/dock indicators, button feedback and reduced-motion handling exist. Independent WCAG/physical-device acceptance remains pending.

features.name: Scoped PWA snapshots
features.description: Explicitly saved read-only snapshots/plans and device drafts are account/school scoped; offline sessions expire and logout blocks cached restoration.

features.name: Explicit offline synchronization
features.description: Reconnect does not silently submit records. Users choose sync, with idempotency, progress and failure visibility; offline emergency delivery is not guaranteed.

features.name: SQLite/PostgreSQL storage
features.description: Local and cloud database adapters, school-scoped private uploads and additive schema upgrades exist; migration and live-hosted validation remain separate work.

features.name: Vercel and integration setup
features.description: Vercel adapter, Supabase/provider setup tools, presence/read-only diagnostics and health/version routes exist; real accounts, private settings and deployment need activation.

features.name: Backup and operational jobs
features.description: Local consistent backups, integrity checks, request IDs/logs and durable maintenance jobs are implemented. Off-host encrypted backups and hosted restore drills remain deployment work.

features.name: Isolated test and acceptance lab
features.description: Disposable seeded practice data blocks external AI/SMS/push calls. Automated SQLite/PostgreSQL/mock-provider checks and a manual acceptance notebook record evidence, not safety certification.

features.name: Verified campus boundary and footprints
features.benefit: Separate legal/authorized site boundaries from visible image outlines and building pins.
features.acceptance: Compare registered geometry against authorized survey/control evidence; store source, date and error.
features.dependencies: School authorization; surveyed or licensed source geometry.

features.name: Georeferencing quality dashboard
features.benefit: Show control-point geometry, independent checkpoint error, CRS and usable image extent.
features.acceptance: Report held-out horizontal RMSE in metres; reject degenerate placement and display uncertainty.
features.dependencies: Surveyed independent checkpoints; coordinate transformations.

features.name: Raster/GeoTIFF and orthomosaic ingest
features.benefit: Use genuine map rasters with CRS/transform instead of manually pretending a photo is GIS.
features.acceptance: Check CRS, transform, scale, nodata, upload limits and tile alignment on known points.
features.dependencies: Licensed georeferenced imagery; raster tiling/storage pipeline.

features.name: DEM and drainage context
features.benefit: Add terrain, slope, drainage and low-lying-area context to field planning.
features.acceptance: Compare DEM resolution/vertical datum and observed drainage; label assumptions and missing culverts.
features.dependencies: Suitable elevation data and hydrology expertise; no generic flood forecast.

features.name: Multi-hazard scenario layers
features.benefit: Compare official flood, landslide, wind and earthquake-related datasets without mixing their meanings.
features.acceptance: Show source, scenario, scale, dates and uncertainty separately; never sum arbitrary scores.
features.dependencies: Licensed current agency layers; a documented combination method.

features.name: Spatial index and large-layer tiling
features.benefit: Keep large campus/municipality datasets responsive on phones.
features.acceptance: Benchmark query latency, memory, tile size and geometric agreement against untiled source.
features.dependencies: Representative datasets and device benchmarks.

features.name: Versioned GIS changes and approvals
features.benefit: Explain when geometry changed, who reviewed it, and which source supports the change.
features.acceptance: Reproduce previous map versions; require review before a new official workspace layer replaces one.
features.dependencies: Version schema, reviewer roles and audit/export policy.

features.name: Geographic uncertainty envelopes
features.benefit: Show where a feature may lie instead of presenting a guessed point as exact.
features.acceptance: Propagate stated location/model error and evaluate whether reference points fall within reported bounds.
features.dependencies: Error estimates and independent survey references.

proposed_groups.title: Stronger visual perception and human correction

features.name: Promptable segmentation assistant
features.benefit: Use SAM/SAM 2-style interactive masks to accelerate outlining, with human corrections.
features.acceptance: Compare IoU/boundary F1 and correction time to manual polygons and a CNN baseline.
features.dependencies: Licensed model weights, compute and locally labeled images.

features.name: Text-guided object grounding
features.benefit: Ground descriptions such as visible debris or blocked doorway into image regions.
features.acceptance: Measure class-specific localization precision/recall and unsupported-query failures.
features.dependencies: Grounding model plus local definitions and negative examples.

features.name: Instance/panoptic campus segmentation
features.benefit: Separate adjacent buildings, paths and vegetation rather than only classifying the whole image.
features.acceptance: Report per-class IoU, instance AP and split/merge errors across held-out locations.
features.dependencies: Pixel/instance ground truth; trained or adapted model.

features.name: Image-quality gate
features.benefit: Flag blur, glare, darkness and inadequate overview coverage before an expensive AI call.
features.acceptance: Measure rejection accuracy and whether retake guidance improves downstream task results.
features.dependencies: Representative good/bad photos and user retake study.

features.name: Self-supervised feature adaptation
features.benefit: Explore DINOv2-style representations when labeled school imagery is limited.
features.acceptance: Compare frozen/adapted embeddings and a supervised CNN with equal data splits and budget.
features.dependencies: Permitted unlabeled imagery; reproducible feature pipeline.

features.name: Cross-view building identity review
features.benefit: Suggest repeated-building matches across frames without inventing unique campus counts.
features.acceptance: Report false merges/missed matches; require human links before registering identities.
features.dependencies: View overlap and independently labeled cross-view correspondences.

features.name: Active-learning annotation queue
features.benefit: Ask staff to label uncertain/diverse examples instead of collecting redundant easy frames.
features.acceptance: Plot learning curves versus random sampling at equal annotation effort.
features.dependencies: Labeling tool, model uncertainty outputs and annotation budget.

features.name: Privacy-preserving image preparation
features.benefit: Offer face/document/plate redaction and show exactly what will leave the device.
features.acceptance: Evaluate missed redactions and detection loss; require a visual consent preview.
features.dependencies: Consent policy, redaction model and privacy evaluation data.

features.name: SfM/MVS campus reconstruction
features.benefit: Create an actual photogrammetric model from overlapping suitable imagery.
features.acceptance: Compare scale, completeness and checkpoint error against measured references.
features.dependencies: Calibrated overlapping imagery, control points and reconstruction compute.

features.name: Orthomosaic generation pipeline
features.benefit: Turn appropriate aerial capture into a real orthorectified map product.
features.acceptance: Validate reprojection/checkpoint error, seams, missing surfaces and georeferencing metadata.
features.dependencies: Capture protocol, photogrammetry tooling and authorized aerial access.

features.name: Visual-inertial/SLAM capture experiment
features.benefit: Study camera trajectory and local geometry for indoor/covered areas where GPS is poor.
features.acceptance: Report trajectory drift and relocalization failures; never treat an unanchored map as geographic truth.
features.dependencies: Compatible devices, IMU calibration and independent route references.

features.name: Semantic campus digital twin
features.benefit: Link verified rooms, assets, geometry and dated evidence to a versioned 3D view.
features.acceptance: Every selected object resolves to a real record and revision; missing/stale information stays visible.
features.dependencies: Verified geometry, stable identifiers and asset governance.

features.name: NeRF/3D Gaussian viewing experiment
features.benefit: Explore smooth recorded-view navigation where capture permits novel-view rendering.
features.acceptance: Measure viewing quality, mobile speed and metric error separately; appearance is not survey accuracy.
features.dependencies: Suitable imagery, trained scene representation and device budget.

features.name: BIM/IFC and CAD alignment
features.benefit: Reuse authorized building models/plans rather than reconstructing known geometry from guesses.
features.acceptance: Validate units, transforms, object IDs and measured correspondence before accepting a source.
features.dependencies: Licensed CAD/BIM files and as-built checks.

features.name: LiDAR/depth-assisted survey option
features.benefit: Study measured depth when available instead of inferring all dimensions from one image.
features.acceptance: Report sensor accuracy, coverage and registration error against independent measurements.
features.dependencies: Compatible depth/LiDAR hardware and calibration.

features.name: Map evidence provenance links
features.benefit: Make every geometric assertion traceable to imagery, measurements and reviewer decisions.
features.acceptance: Open an object and retrieve its source date, capture context, revision and review trail.
features.dependencies: Source retention rules and immutable evidence identifiers.

features.name: Dated before/after change detection
features.benefit: Locate changes between aligned inspections or aerial surveys, reducing repetitive manual review.
features.acceptance: Measure true changes, seasonal/lighting false positives and temporal leakage.
features.dependencies: Co-registered repeat imagery and independently adjudicated change labels.

features.name: Visible surface-damage segmentation
features.benefit: Localize visible cracks/spalling-like surface features for inspection follow-up.
features.acceptance: Report segmentation/localization performance and false alarms; do not infer hidden structural capacity.
features.dependencies: Locally labeled imagery; engineering review of visible-condition categories.

features.name: Measured defect progression
features.benefit: Track a visible feature only when image scale and acquisition geometry support comparison.
features.acceptance: Compare reported dimension change against physical measurements with uncertainty.
features.dependencies: Repeated calibrated measurements; stable observation protocol.

features.name: Optional environmental telemetry fusion
features.benefit: Combine aggregate water-level/rainfall/smoke-device readings with field records.
features.acceptance: Evaluate time alignment, calibration, missing data and independent sensor checks.
features.dependencies: Real maintained sensors; no simulated data shown as live.

features.name: Missing-data-aware anomaly review
features.benefit: Flag unusual validated telemetry or record patterns without declaring an imminent disaster.
features.acceptance: Evaluate false alarms per day, missed events and behavior during sensor outages.
features.dependencies: Sufficient historical data with trustworthy event/maintenance labels.

features.name: Explainable evidence fusion
features.benefit: Present why multiple sources warrant a field check instead of one unexplained danger score.
features.acceptance: Reviewers can inspect source contributions and conflicting evidence; quantify decision consistency.
features.dependencies: Defined evidence rules or validated interpretable model.

features.name: Maintenance prioritization study
features.benefit: Rank documented corrective work by policy, exposure and unresolved evidence for staff approval.
features.acceptance: Compare rank agreement and action timeliness with the existing staff process.
features.dependencies: School-approved criteria, resource limits and historical task outcomes.

features.name: Locally validated domain adaptation
features.benefit: Test whether models transfer between schools, materials, cameras and weather conditions.
features.acceptance: Report per-school/domain performance and abstention; retrain only on permitted training data.
features.dependencies: Multi-school consent and a protected external test set.

features.name: Auditable route graph survey
features.benefit: Record real connectivity, entrances, gates, stairs, surface and clearance rather than deriving a route from appearance alone.
features.acceptance: Field-audit sampled graph edges and document missing/disconnected sections.
features.dependencies: Approved campus path survey and accessibility checks.

features.name: Time-stamped graph closure workflow
features.benefit: Let authorized staff review temporary route closures with expiry and a reason.
features.acceptance: Routes exclude current approved closures and recover only through explicit status policy.
features.dependencies: Reliable staff updates and revision-aware route computation.

features.name: Multi-objective route comparison
features.benefit: Compare distance, accessibility, capacity and approved exposure constraints without promising a safe optimum.
features.acceptance: Benchmark against current Dijkstra and audited route alternatives; expose infeasibility.
features.dependencies: A defensible graph, constraint definitions and tested algorithms.

features.name: Accessibility field audit profiles
features.benefit: Support step-free, ramp/gate, width and assistance requirements with verified data.
features.acceptance: Test representative tasks with participating users and measured edge attributes.
features.dependencies: Voluntary accessibility input and inclusive design review.

features.name: Aggregate congestion scenarios
features.benefit: Explore count-based crowd scenarios without tracking identifiable students.
features.acceptance: Compare simulated queue/travel outcomes to supervised non-emergency drill observations.
features.dependencies: Calibrated aggregate counts and reviewed simulation assumptions.

features.name: Multi-exit assembly assignment
features.benefit: Study how capacities and accessible destinations affect assignment under constraints.
features.acceptance: Report infeasible cases, fairness/accessibility trade-offs and capacity violations.
features.dependencies: Verified destinations, capacities and school-approved constraints.

features.name: Drill rehearsal simulator
features.benefit: Explore what-if closures and delayed communication in a clearly separate training mode.
features.acceptance: No simulated alert or route becomes live; scenario outcome and assumptions remain exportable.
features.dependencies: Scenario boundaries, consent and trained facilitators.

features.name: Responder decision explanation
features.benefit: Show graph edges, closure evidence and stale inputs behind a route recommendation.
features.acceptance: A reviewer can reproduce the result and identify why a route is unavailable or not chosen.
features.dependencies: Versioned inputs and route explanation interface.

features.name: Annotation and adjudication workspace
features.benefit: Create consistent building/condition labels with disagreements reviewed explicitly.
features.acceptance: Measure inter-rater agreement and retain adjudication reasons rather than silently overwriting labels.
features.dependencies: Written label taxonomy and trained annotators.

features.name: Dataset/model version registry
features.benefit: Tie every experiment and draft to exact data, split, code and model revisions.
features.acceptance: A second researcher can reconstruct the exact evaluation artifact from recorded identifiers.
features.dependencies: Artifact storage, hashes and version governance.

features.name: Leakage-resistant split manager
features.benefit: Keep the same building/video sequence or near-duplicate frame out of both train and test.
features.acceptance: Audit splits by school, date, building and capture sequence before evaluation.
features.dependencies: Persistent capture/entity identifiers and deduplication checks.

features.name: Baseline and ablation runner
features.benefit: Compare manual work, GIS-only rules, CNN baseline and each added method under the same budget.
features.acceptance: Produce reproducible task metrics, seeds/configurations and failure examples.
features.dependencies: Runnable baseline implementations and fixed evaluation protocol.

features.name: Uncertainty and calibration evaluation
features.benefit: Test confidence calibration, abstention and out-of-distribution behavior instead of trusting raw scores.
features.acceptance: Report reliability plots/Brier or ECE where appropriate, coverage and error among accepted cases.
features.dependencies: Sufficient held-out labels; task-appropriate confidence interpretation.

features.name: Research consent and data governance ledger
features.benefit: Track permitted purposes, withdrawal rules, anonymization and use restrictions for study data.
features.acceptance: No image is exported to a provider or dataset without its applicable recorded permission.
features.dependencies: Institutional/school review and a workable deletion policy.

features.name: Experiment notebook and result export
features.benefit: Store hypothesis, dataset, run settings, metrics, limitations and reviewer observations together.
features.acceptance: Export a traceable report that distinguishes observed results from plans and mocks.
features.dependencies: Agreed experiment schema and responsible study team.

features.name: Model cards and failure-case gallery
features.benefit: Make intended use, known failure modes and unsupported tasks visible to school staff.
features.acceptance: Each released model has a source/license, test scope, failure examples and rollback version.
features.dependencies: Actual validation evidence; no invented accuracy claims.

features.name: Reviewed Filipino/local-language guidance
features.benefit: Make instructions understandable in the participating school’s languages.
features.acceptance: Test comprehension with target users; review emergency wording and avoid automatic unreviewed translation.
features.dependencies: School-approved terminology and fluent reviewers.

features.name: WCAG-oriented accessibility audit
features.benefit: Verify keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, focus and reduced-motion flows on real devices.
features.acceptance: Resolve documented barriers against an agreed WCAG 2.2 scope and representative tasks.
features.dependencies: Assistive-technology users/test devices and audit time.

features.name: Role-specific preparedness lessons
features.benefit: Offer short reviewed lessons and practice tasks for students, parents and staff.
features.acceptance: Measure comprehension/retention and task completion without claiming real-emergency effectiveness.
features.dependencies: Approved educational content and voluntary participation.

features.name: Drill planning and after-action review
features.benefit: Plan supervised drills, record observations and turn findings into accountable follow-up.
features.acceptance: Compare planned/observed task times and unresolved issues with a documented review.
features.dependencies: School safety approval and a non-emergency protocol.

features.name: Offline QR safety cards
features.benefit: Provide approved room/building instructions without requiring an account for private records.
features.acceptance: QR resolves to the correct dated public guidance; no roster/location information is exposed.
features.dependencies: Explicit public/private content separation and revision policy.

features.name: School feedback and usability loop
features.benefit: Record confusing panels, inaccessible flows and failed tasks instead of adding unused features.
features.acceptance: Prioritize and retest issues from observed tasks across all six roles.
features.dependencies: Representative participants and a structured issue rubric.

features.name: Consent-centered guardian communication
features.benefit: Help approved guardians understand drills and reported status without surveillance.
features.acceptance: Confirm recipient authorization, opt-out behavior and absence of precise-location leakage.
features.dependencies: Relationship verification and reviewed communication policy.

features.name: Preparedness knowledge assistant
features.benefit: Retrieve school-approved procedures with citations and clear uncertainty using RAG.
features.acceptance: Measure citation correctness, retrieval failure and unsafe/unsupported answer rate; no autonomous dispatch.
features.dependencies: Curated current school documents, retrieval evaluation and human escalation.

features.name: Provider budget and availability dashboard
features.benefit: Show quotas, actual latency, failures and explicit lower-cost/single-view options.
features.acceptance: Measure failure handling; no automatic provider switch or unapproved retry sends school data elsewhere.
features.dependencies: Provider telemetry, consent policy and cost tracking.

features.name: On-device/edge inference option
features.benefit: Reduce external transfers and network dependence when a compatible validated model exists.
features.acceptance: Benchmark accuracy, latency, memory, battery and privacy versus server inference on target phones.
features.dependencies: Licensed compact weights, compatible runtime and physical-device testing.

features.name: Defined retention and deletion controls
features.benefit: Apply school-approved retention and deletion rules to images, exports, snapshots and derived models.
features.acceptance: Test expiry/deletion and explain backup/legal hold limits with an audit record.
features.dependencies: Institutional policy, ownership rules and restore/deletion procedures.

features.name: Tamper-evident evidence manifests
features.benefit: Detect changes to evidence and study artifacts without claiming that a hash proves truth.
features.acceptance: Verify image/document hashes, revisions and authorized signatures against test tampering.
features.dependencies: Key management and a threat model; external trust is not automatic.

features.name: Off-host backups and restore drills
features.benefit: Validate recovery of both databases and private media rather than only creating local files.
features.acceptance: Restore into an isolated environment and verify school permissions and evidence integrity.
features.dependencies: Encrypted independent storage and scheduled rehearsals.

features.name: Independent security and load acceptance
features.benefit: Test tenant isolation, abuse, file handling and realistic simultaneous school use before deployment.
features.acceptance: Record findings/remediation and measured performance on the intended hosting plan.
features.dependencies: Authorized external assessment and representative workloads.

features.name: Privacy-preserving multi-school reporting
features.benefit: Study regional patterns using agreed aggregation without exposing identifiable small groups.
features.acceptance: Test suppression/re-identification risks and access rules; no unauthorized raw records leave a school.
features.dependencies: Inter-school agreements and statistical disclosure review.

features.name: Evidence-to-action task workflow
features.benefit: Convert reviewed concerns into assigned work with due dates, evidence and explicit closure approval.
features.acceptance: Measure resolution timeliness and auditability; suggestions never auto-close or certify conditions.
features.dependencies: School responsibilities, repair capacity and a closure verification protocol.
